nodes.label: Gatekeeper Project (fork lineage & maintenance mode)
nodes.rationale: GatekeeperV3.1 is a fork of leonbreidenbach-pc/GatekeeperV3, itself a fork of k8thekat/GatekeeperV2; it is in maintenance mode, not active feature development, aside from the specific fork deltas listed in README.md.

nodes.label: Internationalization (i18n) System
nodes.rationale: Gatekeeper supports English/German as a single global language switchable at runtime by an admin, not per-user Discord client locale; live switching mutates already-registered command/param descriptions and Choice.name via discord.py internals, guarded by a length check for Discord's 1-100 char limit.

nodes.label: Why Use This Fork (Fork Lineage & Deltas)
nodes.norm_label: why use this fork (fork lineage & deltas)

nodes.label: New Feature: Discord Role <-> Whitelist Sync (v3.1)
nodes.norm_label: new feature: discord role <-> whitelist sync (v3.1)

nodes.label: discord.py==2.4.0
nodes.rationale: Deliberately left pinned at 2.4.0 rather than bumped to 2.5.0+ (which handles the Python 3.13 audioop removal natively) because 2.4.0 -> 2.7.x may carry breaking API changes; audioop-lts was added as a conditional dependency instead, fixing the same issue without the upgrade risk.

nodes.label: Production Deployment Log (Hetzner, fullsendhub.de)
nodes.rationale: First real-world deployment of this fork; nearly every fix traced back to the target server running Python 3.13 (not the README's assumed 3.11) combined with a newer CubeCoders AMP build than originally tested against.

nodes.label: AMP Bot Role/Permission Bootstrap Ordering Bug
nodes.norm_label: amp bot role/permission bootstrap ordering bug
nodes.rationale: setup_AMPbotrole() joined the bot to the still-empty Gatekeeper role before setup_Gatekeeper_Permissions() set any permission on it; AMP resolves permissions as a union across roles with deny beating allow, so joining an unconfigured role cancelled the bot's own Super Admin grant mid-setup. Fixed by configuring permissions first, then joining the role.

nodes.label: Core.UserManagement.ViewUserInfo Self-Check Crash Fix
nodes.rationale: check_GatekeeperRole_Permissions()'s self-lookup (Core/GetAMPUserInfo) was rejected with Unauthorized Access on a per-instance delegate session even though node-based permission checks had just passed; unhandled indexing of the False result threw a TypeError that killed the AMP Handler thread. Fixed by checking isinstance(result, dict) before indexing, treating a rejected self-lookup as a non-fatal warning for InstanceID != 0 while keeping it critical for the main instance.

nodes.label: Escape External Text Before Embed Markdown Interpolation
nodes.norm_label: escape external text before embed markdown interpolation
nodes.rationale: /link steam and /link minecraft interpolated unescaped Steam personaname/Minecraft IGN into markdown (clickable link / bold text); a rogue underscore or other markdown special char in a display name would partially misrender as emphasis. Fixed via discord.utils.escape_markdown() on the display text only, preserving the clickable link.

nodes.label: AMP HTTP Session Reuse (requests.Session())
nodes.rationale: CallAPI() previously opened a brand-new requests.post() per call with no connection reuse; switched to a single shared AMPHandler.http_session = requests.Session() reused across the main instance and all per-server AMPInstances, pooling TCP/TLS connections since they all target the same AMP host.

nodes.label: AMP Loopback Reachability False Lead
nodes.rationale: Originally attributed to AMP requiring the public domain over loopback, but that was a false lead caused by bad/mistyped credentials in the original curl test; loopback (http://127.0.0.1:8080) works fine and is now used, removing an unnecessary round trip to the public internet for every AMP API call.

nodes.label: AMP Permission Node Drift Reconciliation
nodes.rationale: perms_super()/perms_whitelist_only() reconciled against a live Core/GetPermissionsSpec dump: 4 stale/renamed nodes fixed (including a lost LocalFileBackup.* grant with no modern equivalent found), plus several wildcard-granted-but-unused nodes excluded (Store.*, ADS.DatastoreManagement.*, unused Settings.* category, etc.).

nodes.label: Python 3.13 Bootstrap Compatibility Fixes
nodes.rationale: Server runs Python 3.13, which broke pip install (stale requirements.txt pins), haggis's private-lock-based logging monkeypatch, and discord.py's audioop import; a batch of one-fix-per-commit changes across requirements.txt/AMP.py/logger.py/amp_permissions.py restored a working bootstrap.

nodes.label: Per-Lookup-Type Commands Need Subcommands, Not Enum Param
nodes.norm_label: per-lookup-type commands need subcommands, not enum param
nodes.rationale: /user info used one command with an identifier_type Choice plus two always-visible params; Discord slash commands cannot conditionally show/hide a parameter based on another parameter's value, so both fields always showed regardless of type picked. Split into /user info discord|minecraft|steam subcommands, each exposing only its relevant required param.

nodes.label: -whitelist-only Flag Needs Live Verification
nodes.rationale: perms_whitelist_only() deliberately grants no ADS.* node; it's undocumented whether AMP's ADSModule/GetInstances requires one, so a fresh -whitelist-only restart could lose instance visibility entirely if it turns out to need one - must be live-tested before production use.

nodes.label: Fixed Broken pyproject.toml
nodes.rationale: An unterminated string in pyproject.toml's authors table blocked pip install . and python -m build; same underlying defect independently described in changelog.md's 4.7.5 entry as a missing closing quote.
